instruction: Mirror sweep — blind-spot protection for the 4 SINGLE_EXECUTABLE_NO_DUPLICATE judgments. Read-only. Find the parallel mirror (root ID starting 1Rva_gSN...), enumerate it in full, hash the terminal HTML of each mirrored track, compare to the corresponding capsule authority SHA, and record facts and hashes only. Adjudication changes are CENTRAL's.
write_scope: Evidence JSON only. No Drive object was created, modified, renamed, moved or deleted. No manifest duplicate_variant_status was changed.

mirror_root.folder_name_note: The root folder's own name was not fetched in this sweep; only its contents were enumerated. Its identity is established by the folder ID alone.
mirror_root.discovered_via: SRC071 residual resolution in the #643 addendum: Drive API files.get on 17cCBo7cObMbytQ8pHrJACEkfIpGCbaCb returned parents["1_nuRwalky34UX2ebaaocvEyLQlw1N41C"], and walking that chain upward two levels reached this root.
mirror_root.what_it_is: A parallel mirror of the track-numbered design deliverable set, created outside the canonical design root. It is not reachable from any per-capsule enumeration path, which is why the earlier per-capsule enumerations were accurate as far as they went but blind to it.

method.enumeration: rclone v1.75.0 lsf with --drive-root-folder-id 1Rva_gSNWwiguJDmaWUODd926NStpLHlW and -R for a full recursive listing of the mirror
method.download: rclone copyto under the same --drive-root-folder-id, one terminal HTML per track
method.hashing: local Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 over the downloaded bytes
method.independent_corroboration: each mirrored track folder carries a SHA256SUMS.txt written by whoever produced the copy; every one was downloaded and compared against the locally recomputed digest
method.comparison_target: each capsule's fresh_drive.sha256 pin, read from the repo at BASE
method.tool_advisory: gdrive: This remote uses rclone's shared Google Drive client_id, which is being retired and will stop working during 2026. Emitted on every rclone call; all reads succeeded.

inventory.shape: Every mirrored track holds exactly one terminal HTML deliverable and one SHA256SUMS.txt asserting its digest. This is a distribution/audit artifact set, not a working design tree.
inventory.nested_subfolders: 17 tracks additionally keep their terminal revision subfolder (e.g. 56, 57, 58, 60, 64, 65, 66, 69, 71, 72, 73, 74); the rest hold the HTML flat at the track level.

priority_1_single_executable_no_duplicat.instruction: Protect the 4 SINGLE_EXECUTABLE_NO_DUPLICATE judgments, each made by a different path than the per-capsule enumerations and sharing the same 'the mirror is outside the search scope' blind spot.

results.note: The mirror holds a byte-identical copy of the authority. The SINGLE_EXECUTABLE_NO_DUPLICATE status does not survive this sweep.

The mirror holds the V1.2 candidate, 4840 bytes smaller than the V1.3 authority and content-different by hash. This is genuine revision history, not a duplicate. The SINGLE_EXECUTABLE_NO_DUPLICATE status stands on content grounds, though the enumeration that produced it never covered the mirror.
Byte-identical copy of the authority at the V1.2 revision-folder path. The SINGLE_EXECUTABLE_NO_DUPLICATE status does not survive this sweep.

Byte-identical copy of the authority, preserving the same track/revision nesting as the canonical location. The mirror reproduces the canonical path structure. The SINGLE_EXECUTABLE_NO_DUPLICATE status does not survive this sweep.

priority_2_duplicate_copy_same_sha.instruction: These statuses already assert a copy exists, so an additional mirror copy does not change the value. Findings recorded only.

results.note: An additional byte-identical copy. The canonical enumeration recorded three objects carrying these bytes; the mirror adds a fourth, outside that scope. Status value unchanged.
An additional byte-identical copy, flat at the track level. The canonical enumeration recorded two objects carrying these bytes; the mirror adds a third. Status value unchanged.
The mirror's track-69 terminal deliverable is a different, smaller V4 artifact, not the v3 authority. Revision history only; no additional authority copy.
Already resolved and adjudicated in the #643 addendum; the mirror copy is the basis of that adjudication. Recorded here for inventory completeness.

absent_tracks.recorded_with_method: Absence is recorded, not omitted. The proof is the full recursive listing of the mirror root: 227 lines covering 70 track folders, and no entry whose track number is 47, 62, 63 or 68. Verified explicitly by pattern match against the listing.

absent.note: Track 47 has no folder in the mirror, so no additional copy exists there. Existing three-way identical set in the canonical tree is unaffected.
Track 62 has no folder in the mirror. Existing two-way identical set is unaffected.
Track 63 has no folder in the mirror and no SRC capsule is bound to it in this repo.
Track 68 has no folder in the mirror. SRC068 is a dual media variant with no single Drive authority hash, so the sweep cannot compare it; the absence is recorded regardless.

corpus_wide_limit.note: This sweep covers the one parallel mirror that is known, and it was enumerated exhaustively. It is not a Drive-wide duplicate search. No corpus-wide Drive name or hash query was obtainable: the shared client_id is quota-limited on the Queries metric and a files.list name predicate was demonstrably ignored by that client (it returned an unfiltered paginated listing with incompleteSearch false). No third copy of any authority is established or excluded.
corpus_wide_limit.established_copies: per capsule, as recorded in each readback and here
corpus_wide_limit.unestablished: any additional copy outside the canonical design-root subtree and this mirror

summary.three_way_confirmation: every compared digest matches the locally recomputed hash AND the mirror's own SHA256SUMS.txt entry

adjudication.note: duplicate_variant_status was not changed in any manifest. manifest_falsified flags in priority_1_single_executable_no_duplicate are factual findings about whether a status survives contact with the mirror; re-adjudicating them is CENTRAL's action.
